source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

result.summary:
REGISTRY (Step 0.5): No resolved entry matches this symptom. Closest: ISS-0909 (resolved, PR #2051) sub-fix (d), which INTRODUCED the qa-uat-env protocol and the `Token:` line contract (header lines 26-38; fetch_credential lines 300-303) from an adapter, never against the real qa-uat-env.sh. ISS-0894 (resolved) defined the actor naming. So this is not a recurrence of a fix that failed to hold: it is a latent defect in ISS-0909(d)'s assumed output format (protocol guessed, not verified against the real source). No other docs/issues entry mentions Token:/NO_PASSWORD. docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml is not on this branch (PR #2071), as the handoff said.

ROOT CAUSE: scripts/uat_preflight.sh fetch_credential, line 300-303 (qa-uat-env branch): `r = run_cred(["token", user], 60); for l in r.stdout.splitlines(): if l.startswith("Token:"): return ("token", ...)`. The only accepted form is a line starting with literal `Token:`. A real qa-uat-env.sh prints a bare JWT, so no line matches, the loop falls through to `return (None, None)` (line 306), and try_login (lines 321-323) maps kind None to ("NO_PASSWORD", None) before any HTTP call. The bare-JWT line is silently dropped, there is no diagnostic distinguishing 'source printed something unparseable' from 'source printed nothing', and the `except Exception: pass` (304-305) also swallows errors (timeouts, non-zero exits). Every actor login therefore reports NO_PASSWORD, downstream actors check becomes `[GAP] ... login failed: actor-...(NO_PASSWORD)` and tenant/app_roles checks become UNKNOWN. The invariant broken: the script's input contract (Token: line) does not match the real producer's output (bare JWT). Why no test caught it: there is no preflight test anywhere (no test/ file references uat_preflight; only scripts/uat_preflight.sh exists), and the ISS-0909 verification used an adapter that emitted the `Token:` form, which is precisely the assumption under test.

REPRODUCTION (real script, real code path, not a re-implementation): fake credential source in scratchpad (prints stderr noise, a stdout line `WARN something`, then a JWT-shaped line `eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ4In0.c2lnbmF0dXJl`; variant 2 prefixes the JWT line with `Token: `). Run with UAT_PF_BASH=<git bash> (the default `bash` on this Windows host is the WSL stub and does not work from Python subprocess; note for test shape), --base-url http://127.0.0.1:9 (unreachable on purpose), --credential-protocol qa-uat-env, --scenarios containing one swiftroute scenario (actors actor-swiftroute-lena, actor-swiftroute-marco). Results: bare JWT -> `[GAP] swiftroute-shipment-attach-delivery-note/actors: login failed: actor-swiftroute-lena(NO_PASSWORD), actor-swiftroute-marco(NO_PASSWORD)`. Same source with `Token: ` prefix -> `credential validity : actor-swiftroute-lena@swiftroute=BAD_CRED, ...` i.e. the token was parsed and reached the HTTP verification (BAD_CRED only because the base URL is a dead port). The NO_PASSWORD vs BAD_CRED delta isolates parsing as the sole cause. Noise line `WARN something` in both variants was harmlessly ignored by the current code.

RECOMMENDED FIX SHAPE (for CODE-DESIGNER; do not implement here):
1. Only change the else (qa-uat-env) branch of fetch_credential (lines 300-303); qa-login branch untouched. Factor a small pure helper (e.g. parse_token_line(stdout) -> str|None) so it is unit-testable.
2. For each stdout line: strip whitespace; if it starts with `Token:` take the remainder stripped (keep existing form, backward compat with the ISS-0909 adapter); else if it fullmatches r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]*' (three dot-separated base64url segments; allow empty 3rd segment for unsigned? designer decides, recommend requiring non-empty all three, and that the first two segments start with `eyJ`-agnostic, i.e. do not over-constrain) return it. Take the LAST qualifying line or first? Recommend first match, consistent with existing loop, and ignore everything else (warnings, blank lines, `export X=...` lines, banners). Use re.fullmatch on the stripped line so a warning sentence that merely contains dots cannot match (a sentence has spaces; `a.b.c` style hostnames like `auth.qa.bizdala.com` WOULD match three segments, so designer should consider requiring a minimum length, e.g. header segment >= ~10 chars, or require the header segment to begin with `eyJ` (base64 of `{"`), which every JWT does; recommend the `eyJ` prefix check to exclude hostnames/versions).
3. Never log or print the token; keep it in memory only (existing contract, header lines 49-51). Do not add debug prints of the raw stdout. If nothing parses but stdout had non-empty output, optionally record a non-secret reason (e.g. 'source produced output but no token line') so the gap table can say so instead of the misleading NO_PASSWORD; designer's call, must not echo stdout. Also consider narrowing `except Exception: pass` so a timeout/non-zero exit is distinguishable (optional scope; do not widen without need).
4. Docs: update header protocol paragraph lines 33-38 (states `prints a line Token: <bearer-token>`) to say it accepts either a `Token: <jwt>` line or a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments), other lines ignored. grep of scripts/README.md and docs/agents/workflows/WF-05_uat_run.md found NO occurrences of `Token:` or `qa-uat-env`, so those need no change (scripts/README.md apparently does not mention the protocol; verify only).
5. try_login token branch (lines 324-339) needs no change.

TEST SHAPE (no existing preflight tests): minimal in-repo test, e.g. a shell/Python harness or ExUnit test under test/scripts/ (TEST-DESIGNER decides) that (a) creates a temp fake credential-source script printing a bare JWT (plus noise line) for `token <user>`, (b) runs scripts/uat_preflight.sh with --credential-protocol qa-uat-env against a tiny temp scenario dir with one swiftroute-style actor and a dead/localhost base URL, and asserts output does NOT contain NO_PASSWORD (expect BAD_CRED or an HTTP-verified state); (c) same for `Token:`-prefixed form (regression guard); (d) noise-only output -> NO_PASSWORD still; (e) hostname-like line `auth.qa.bizdala.com` must not be accepted as a token. Better still, a local stdlib http.server stub returning 200 for GET /api/v1/me/modules to assert OK end to end. Test must resolve the bash interpreter (set UAT_PF_BASH) because on Windows the default `bash` is the WSL stub; must be skipped gracefully if no python/bash, and must never print tokens. The script exits 1 on any GAP, so assert on output, not exit status.

CONFIDENCE: root cause confirmed by running the actual script with both input variants; no speculation. Files modified by me: this handoff only (scratchpad files live outside the repo).
